kind: public distribution audit and matched local Reviewer diagnostic
repository: PranavMishra28/kryn changed from PRIVATE to PUBLIC after a Git-history and release-asset audit. This is source visibility, not a new release or a quality qualification.

audit.history: Gitleaks 8.30.1 scanned Git history. Eleven generic-api-key hits were checked by file/key and were SHA256 hash fields, not identified credentials. Tracked-tree patterns and commit messages were also screened. This is not a guarantee against every kind of private content.
audit.releases: Twelve historical prereleases/draft releases were inspected before visibility changed. Downloaded release checksums matched every installer and wheel; wheel paths were checked for traversal. Gitleaks hits in the v0.1.9 qualification asset were SHA256 fields. Existing release assets, tags and descriptions were not rewritten or deleted.

Public v0.2.0 installer, SHA256SUMS and wheel downloaded without GitHub credentials; installer SHA256 b66e4332b4951c4abbe37c59db6865f076117e4ebc8d4588ad6a180929bc55b5 and the wheel/checksum contents matched the published release. Installer --help passed; no second-account GUI install was claimed.

reviewer_comparison.setup: Same copied known-bad review-queue Git workspace and identical read-only prompt; installed 9B Default baseline versus a candidate plugin exposing a scoped read-only per-file Git diff tool. Both used guarded native OpenCode sessions; raw traces remain under /private/tmp/kryn-review-diff-20261001-{baseline,candidate}/evidence/reviewer.
reviewer_comparison.baseline: Native completion in 168.56 seconds, eight read calls. Missed the independent oracle's changed original /api/entries shape, missing Edit control and actual export HTTP 400, while inventing required reviewed CSV/PATCH fields that contradict the original contract.
reviewer_comparison.candidate: Native completion in 216.207 seconds, nine read calls and zero calls to the new diff tool. Missed the same material regressions and added false findings, including a selector mismatch while quoting matching selector/ID text. This was not an accuracy gain.
reviewer_comparison.decision: Reverted the diff-tool candidate and its test. Do not promote a Reviewer wording/tool change on source-citation count or apparent detail; independent API/browser contract evidence remains authoritative. Reviewer accuracy gate stays failed.

release_decision: No new tag, version or release. Autonomous coding/UI, Reviewer accuracy, two-compaction/restart application acceptance and sustained-use gates remain failed.
